title: Bacillus prodigiosus colonies on four agar plates after ten minutes' counting aloud, Hübener, 1898
description: Bar chart, colonies counted on four agar plates 50 cm below the mouth after ten minutes of counting aloud in an ordinary voice, the mouth first rinsed with a suspension of Bacillus prodigiosus. Without a mask, 362; with the mask covered by one layer of gauze, 20; with two layers, 0. Data: Hübener, Zeitschrift für Hygiene und Infectionskrankheiten 28 (1898), table VII.
heading: RED COLONIES ON FOUR PLATES · 10 MINUTES' SPEECH
